dialogue.speaker: Olivia
dialogue.text: You just came back from a trip, right? Tell me everything!

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, I spent ten days abroad. It was unforgettable.

dialogue.speaker: Olivia
dialogue.text: Wow! Where did you go first?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I started in the capital, but on the first day I got lost in the old streets.

dialogue.speaker: Olivia
dialogue.text: Oh no! How did you find your way?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: A friendly local showed me the way and even invited me for coffee.

dialogue.speaker: Olivia
dialogue.text: That is lovely. What was the best moment of the trip?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Watching the sunset from a hill. The view was incredible.

dialogue.speaker: Olivia
dialogue.text: Would you recommend the country to other people?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Absolutely. I would go back tomorrow if I could.

dialogue.speaker: Olivia
dialogue.text: Then show me your photos, please!

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Of course. I took more than five hundred pictures.
